key_points: Wells Fargo cut GE Aerospace price target and downgraded the stock on Sep 30, coinciding with a 1.6% price drop.
Kalkine.ca raised GE Aerospace's full-year outlook after a strong Q2 2026, providing a positive catalyst.
Much of the recent coverage consists of comparative articles and generic commentary, which are largely noise.
GE Vernova (the spun-off energy business) has shown recent strength, but that does not directly affect GE Aerospace shares.
No material earnings surprise, guidance change, or major news beyond analyst adjustments.
